conjecture: Q237: the height-graded ribbon-addition family R_e(t) lives inside Postnikov's affine nil-Temperley-Lieb algebra A_n, with the ribbon height equal to the orientation statistic of the monomial's heap; Postnikov's e_r and h_r are its t=infinity and t=0 endpoints, and the truncation of eq:e-h-AN is the full-wrap ribbon e=n.

tree.approach: identify R_e(t) with an element of A_n[t] and locate Postnikov's eq:e-h-AN on the t-line; compare INDEX SETS, not conclusions (the symmetry theorem is true, so no check of the conclusion can fail)

children.approach: Theorem A: for an interval J of length e in Z/nZ, the 2^{e-1} monomials of A_n with support J are indexed by orientations eps of J's internal edges; a_{J,eps} acts as the cylindric e-ribbon addition at min J of height |eps|. Hence R_e(t) = sum_J sum_eps t^{|eps|} a_{J,eps} in A_n[t].

Postnikov l.2806: kappa -> a_kappa is a bijection between cylindric shapes mod ~ and nonvanishing monomials of A_n. Read at source 2026-09-23. Used only as a consistency check on Theorem A, which is proved independently.

Corollary: R_e(0) is the connected part of Postnikov's h_e and [t^{e-1}]R_e(t) the connected part of e_e; the duality e<->h is t -> 1/t, i.e. Omega R_e(t) Omega = t^{e-1} R_e(1/t), verified n<=7 all k

Theorem C: the truncation e_i h_j = 0 (i+j>n) and the t^n correction term of eq:e-h-AN are properties of the INDEX SET, not of the t-family. The correction equals (-1)^{n-k} q Id, i.e. the single quantum relation e_k h_{n-k} = q; the ribbon-side mechanism is the e=n wrap-around ribbon, which Postnikov excludes by requiring I proper. On the semi-infinite wedge (index set Z) there is no wrap, hence no truncation.

Theorem B (VERIFIED, NOT PROVED): t=-1 is the unique t with [R_e(t), h_j]=0 for all e,j (n<=6, 2<=k<=n-2); Newton's identity r h_r = sum_e R_e(-1) h_{r-e} holds for r<=n-1 (n<=7, all k, exact symbolic); defect at r=n is (-1)^{k-1}(n-k) q. This is the cylindric counterpart of Q75 (R_e(t) is a multiplication operator exactly at t=-1).

Given Newton in A_n plus Postnikov's quantum Pieri (cor:pieri-AN) and the presentation eq:QH, R_e(-1) is quantum multiplication by p_e -- the quantum Murnaghan-Nakayama rule. Proved CONDITIONAL on thmB-t-equals-minus-one.

children.reason: FALSE. Checked n=2..7, all k: holds only for the trivial k=0 and k=n. Already fails at n=2,k=1 by a factor (1-t) in the z^1 coefficient: Q's z-coefficient is h_1 = sum_i a_i, whereas the Hall-Littlewood q_1 = (1-t) h_1. Q(z;t) is the height-graded RIBBON-STRIP adder, not the Hall-Littlewood generating function; the weightings differ (t^height per ribbon vs (1-t) per connected component).
